controlled.label: rollback4x-enemy-index-deep8-cpu4-01
controlled.scope: Three sequential worlds in one throttled renderer; manual native ticks. Correctness and recovery call pressure, not real RTC, native rAF presentation cadence or game FPS.
gates: 1800 logical frames and confirmed endpoint per peer

releaseSeries.scope: Same frozen harness/helper, build flags and deterministic frame input tape. Actual correction depth and host activity remain observed variables; ABBA ordering cannot eliminate host or network variance.

inputResponseFollowup.label: rollback4x-enemy-index-burst-response-01
inputResponseFollowup.condition: After candidate correctness gates pass. Same CPU, headed and diagnostic controls as the release series.
inputResponseFollowup.scope: Independent input intent completeness plus observed capture/presentation latency; retain short held-mask misses and include startup/tail.

primary: Continuous new-state rate and p50/p95/p99/max intervals including terminal closure
C++ callback elapsed work distribution, correction and resimulation counts
Network gap and pacing together with host activity
Independent response cohort including missing captures
notAcceptance: Full trace or anomaly collector success
No eligible 250 ms episode in a finite sample
A single improvement under changing host load
Manual controlled-tick throughput treated as rAF FPS
interpretation.failures: Retain all labels and failures. A correctness regression blocks candidate adoption and is investigated before continuing dependent performance gates; infrastructure failures are recorded with any explicit protocol revision. No silent reruns or discarded noisy samples.

operational.heavyWork: All builds, browser runs, performance and test commands serialized by root; read-only offline review may overlap.
operational.repository: Local reviewable commits only; no push, merge, deploy, canonical edits or unrelated process termination.
